name: HTF Trend Trendline Breakout -- Medium Variant [Manual Build]
raw_text: HTF Trend Trendline Breakout. Bias TF: 4H + 1H, trend must be confirmed on both (valid_structure_trend). Entry TF: 15m. NEW CONCEPT -- Trendline breakout: on the entry TF, connect the 2 most recent confirmed swing points (lows for an uptrend, highs for a downtrend) into a line, detect the first close beyond it in the HTF trend's direction. Long: HTF uptrend (4H+1H) confirmed, entry-TF trendline (from swing-lows) broken UP. Short: HTF downtrend confirmed, entry-TF trendline (from swing-highs) broken DOWN. Stop-loss: recent swing-low(long)/swing-high(short), 0.65% buffer (cost_model-verified safe). Take-profit: NONE fixed -- structural trailing stop only (rides the trend, allows 1:10+ RR). Optional soft filters: half size on weekends or when the 1H regime is sideways. No session restriction, 24/7. Risk 1% default.
